description: This file contains a test script for testing Git push options and hooks in a repository, including setup, configuration, and various push scenarios involving push options and hook interactions.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets up or updates a hook script in a specified Git configuration directory.

methods.name: test_tool
methods.description: A utility used within the test to simulate or validate the proc-receive hook behavior.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Processes output for consistency/stability for comparison.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Saves formatted expected output for test comparison.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares Git references between repositories or states to expected references.
